current_formal_task.semantic: Most recent formal task represented by canonical Current source.

latest_architecture_changing_task.semantic: Most recent task that changed architecture identity from canonical task identity; it may differ from the current formal task.

release_candidate_task.semantic: Task identity fixed by the formal execution contract before release-candidate formation.

publication_witness_task.semantic: Control-repository task responsible for observation-time remote-ref publication evidence; it grants no architecture authority.

claim_ceiling: This model separates repository-local execution, architecture identity and publication observation roles; it does not grant Owner authority, truth authority, production readiness or epistemic acceptance.
